_comment: A lone block of 64 Infantry (8 files of 8, normal order, 18 wu pitch) facing north, doubled to 16 files of 4 by the half-file explicatio read inward, as Bingham's 1616 note on Aelian 33 has it: each wing's intervals open toward the middle. The rear half of each left-wing file steps right into its interval and each right-wing file's steps left, then comes up it behind its hemilochites. Both middle intervals open between the two middle files, so only the right-hand one (old file 4) stands; the left flank steps out 5 file pitches (837 to 747) and the right 3 (963 to 1017), where the default, outward, steps each out 4. So the block's position ends at x 882, a file pitch left of the 900 it would keep outward. The front rank keeps its line at y 577 (front_rank_line -577; the dump's facing is (0, -1), so the value is minus y). The nearest two men came 4.47 wu apart at tick 94 (one pair within the 4.5 wu body radius at ticks 92 and 94, as the default half-file drill's 4.44 wu, TODO(#1974)); none at ticks 120, 180, 240. The drill ends by tick 604. Measured 2026-11-13 on FULL 2-tick dumps from the order to tick 760, seed run 0; the drill plays out identically on seed runs 0 to 4 (no enemy, no roll). On main, which has no readings, the script's explicatio block is not read and B deals the default drill, so the position expect fails there. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd, whose explicatio block sets the readings the B key deals (tools/demo/DemoExplicatio.gd); world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
